evidence.decision: Builds remote focus routes around distant viewing, explicit activation and the current system viewer rather than touch targets or pointer hover.
evidence.artifact: Requires a focus-route map and corrected screen/profile flow or implementation, with selected-item discovery destinations.
evidence.transformation: Cooking-video app replaces tiny tabs/hover and a shared permanent profile with focusable categories, highlighted recipe activation and viewer-owned history.
evidence.verification: Fails invisible focus, remote traps and cross-profile personal data; actual traversal/TV legibility/focus enlargement need supported hardware.
evidence.applicability: Keeps ordinary browsing usable with Siri Remote, adds controller/companion/voice only where warranted and treats provider/TV discovery as conditional.
evidence.handoffs: Routes detailed focus movement and remote controls to their topics and shared viewing to SharePlay only when selected.
evidence.distinctiveness: Across-room hierarchy, remote exits and household viewer ownership are consequential television-specific decisions.
